name: Pepper
summary: A Euchre-like trick-taking bidding game where teams bid to choose trump and first to 30 points wins.
rules_text: Pepper uses a 24-card deck 9,10,J,Q,K,A in four suits. Deal six cards to each player. Bidding starts left of dealer: each player may bid 1 to 5, Little Pepper (6 tricks), or Big Pepper (6 tricks double), or pass. Each bid must be higher than last. Auction ends when three players pass after a bid. High bidder names trump suit or no-trump and leads first trick. Rank in trump is J of trump (Right Bower), J of same color (Left Bower), A,K,Q,10,9. In other suits A,K,Q,10,9. Must follow suit if able; trick won by highest trump or highest of led suit if no trump. Winner leads next. Scoring: contracting team if it makes at least its bid scores 1 point per trick taken, otherwise loses 6 points. Big Pepper is +12 if 6 tricks taken, -12 if not. Defenders always score 1 per trick taken. First team to 30+ wins, higher score breaks tie.
rating_reason: Euchre-style trick-taking, hidden hands, strategic bidding/trump.
